scope: JIT resident cache replacement with fewer available instruction bytes
change: Invalidate stale resident and attempt decoding available replacement bytes; incomplete replacements still decline without changing guest state.

qualification.before: One regression test failed on original code: shorter NOP replacement returned nil.
qualification.after: 112 tests in 2 suites passed; includes baseline and optimizing tiers and incomplete replacement state preservation.

limitations: No end-to-end guest boot or speedup claim.
Agent bit-scan emitter changes excluded from this qualification and commit.
